role: Complete recursive current test-code support identity census and conservative import/launch candidates DATA; no semantic qualification

method.primary_membership: Unchanged exact private_npm_source_paths independent enumeration, checker excluded; primary rows remain census-primary-v1.json
method.test_code_population: Every recursive tests regular file suffix .py/.mjs/.js/.cjs/.ts/.sh; reject any linked descendant and linked path component. Includes per-method subprocess launch targets regardless of import graph. No filename/purity exception.
method.support_closure: Seed all test code and exact handoff tools Python; scan primary and all support recursively for resolved first-party imports and every literal code path that resolves to an existing first-party file. Literal path inclusion is conservative and does not claim execution reachability.
method.git_attribution: One git cat-file --batch command verifies every current primary/support byte against the recorded committed HEAD; tracked symlink/gitlink rejected
method.trusted_checker_exclusion: Only scripts/check-dependency-eligibility.py is the existing trusted checker exclusion; retain every literal/import observation without binding its self-referential hash
method.generated_targets: Existing untracked targets such as dist imports recorded unadmitted; never scanned as current committed source or admitted by source identity
method.candidate_parsers: Python AST imports/loaders/subprocess calls; JavaScript conservative lexical import, literal path and launch-call candidates. Emitted templates/comments may overinclude. Aliases/computed paths require contextual review; no unresolved target is granted coverage.
method.execution: Local Python standard-library static analysis and read-only Git with gc.auto=0/maintenance.auto=false only; no repository/dependency/checker/archive/network/compiler/build/Actions execution
